results.name: App loads from the app:// origin inside the desktop window
Desktop bridge available; no Node.js in the page
Database in the application data folder (not a browser profile)
Automatic daily backup written to the backup folder at start-up
Excel saved through the native Save flow
After export: “Open” (default application) and “Show in folder” offered
PDF report saved directly (printToPDF, A4, multi-page)
Manual backup to folder (write-then-rename, valid backup)
Settings → Storage shows data and backup folders
External navigation blocked inside the app window
A newer published version is announced, with a Download button (nothing installed automatically)
Download opens step-by-step install help; the same version is reported as up to date
Projects persist after closing and reopening the app
Automatic backup runs once per day (not on every start)
Calculation results identical in the desktop build
